about: The causal map: what can cause what in a GvG match, as reasoned by Denning and Claude and found in data. Each node is measured; each node's model may only use the links pointing into it, measured earlier in time. The data decides how much each link matters (status: hypothesis, supported, rejected; mechanical = a formula, not learned). Denning can add, correct or remove links; each change is logged with its reason. Rendered to knowledge/causal-map.md by tools/replay_analysis/causal_map.py.

nodes.name: Build features
nodes.description: what each team's bars can do: interrupts, knockdowns, snares, Blind, enchantment and energy removal, prots and blocks, Aura of Stability count, condition and hex removal, healing, spike capacity, speed, measured Lord damage
nodes.how: counts from data/skills.json properties of each bar (scales to builds never seen)

nodes.name: Matchup
nodes.description: each build feature against the enemy's answer to it (enemy knockdowns v own Aura of Stability, enemy Blind v own removal, enemy spike v own prot stack, enemy energy denial v own energy hiding, split capacity v defence)
nodes.how: pairs of build features; their effect comes from data, never a label

nodes.name: Team strength
nodes.description: how strong each team is: the guild's fitted rating and the lineup of players who actually played (MAT weighted by a measured amount), blended by how well each predicts later results
nodes.how: strength.py (blend), lineup.py (people's records from every stored result, time ordered), context.py (matchup, map and flux beyond strength; off until it beats strength alone)

nodes.name: Map geometry
nodes.description: Y (flag spawn to stand), routes, where the pits and stand are

nodes.name: Clock
nodes.description: match time, both teams' res timers, the boost clock

nodes.name: Allocation
nodes.description: where each team's 8 players are every second: groups, who is in each, on flag duty, splitting, defending, dead
nodes.how: state and scoreboard (groups, zones, flag duty)

nodes.name: Phase
nodes.description: a stretch with a stable global setup; ends at a collapse, death, res or capture
nodes.how: to build: from changes in allocation

nodes.name: Plan
nodes.description: each team's intent in a phase (8v8 brawl, flag game, split pressure, holding in its pit, power play, late Lord push; more found in data)
nodes.how: to build: inferred from the setup; plans found and amended from data (Denning)

nodes.name: Jobs
nodes.description: what each group must do given the plan: strong side converts, weak side holds safely, runner caps and returns, defenders hold the pit
nodes.how: to build: from the plan and the numbers in each group

nodes.name: Damage potential v healing
nodes.description: the damage a group can actually put out (measured per role and build, not heads: a mesmer is not a hammer) against the healing and prots it faces
nodes.how: to build: measured damage per second per role and build against players, plus healers' measured healing

nodes.name: Mesmers free to defend
nodes.description: whether each mesmer is in the fight, carrying, or defending elsewhere
nodes.how: to build: from allocation and flag duty

nodes.name: Target choice
nodes.description: who the damage is put on (monks, midline, out of position players)

nodes.name: Burst timing
nodes.description: whether the damage dealers' hits land together
nodes.how: spread of hit times within bursts

nodes.name: Offensive interrupts
nodes.description: interrupts on enemy monks and key enemy skills
nodes.how: interrupt events by target and skill

nodes.name: Defensive interrupts
nodes.description: interrupts on enemy players pressuring the own team (spikers, Blind, strips, energy denial)

nodes.name: Condition removal
nodes.description: removal of Blind, Weakness and other conditions from own damage dealers and monks, and how fast; hex removal: the right hexes removed (valued from data) and how fast
nodes.how: effects intervals and removal casts; eventlayer.py hex_removals

nodes.name: Prot timing
nodes.description: prots and Infuse relative to the first big hit (pre-prot, on time, late)

nodes.name: Heal targeting
nodes.description: healing on players under threat against healing elsewhere and overheal

nodes.name: Kiting and spacing
nodes.description: distance from enemy mesmer and ranger, kiting toward safety, standing still before contact

nodes.name: Collapse timing
nodes.description: when a team turns players onto a group, against res timers, enemy runner and enemy numbers

nodes.name: Run timing and runner choice
nodes.description: who runs and when after the enemy's capture

nodes.name: Split answer
nodes.description: who answers a split and how fast

nodes.name: Res timing
nodes.description: whether a team waits for its dead to return before fighting

nodes.name: Peel
nodes.description: hitting or shutting down the players attacking an ally

nodes.name: Commitment
nodes.description: damage dealers in range and attacking during a power play or kill attempt

nodes.name: Pressure
nodes.description: damage per second a group puts out

nodes.name: Damage uptime
nodes.description: share of time damage dealers are actually attacking or casting; lost damage-seconds by cause: knocked down, interrupted, Blind, Weakness, hexed, carrying, kiting, peeling, out of range, dead

nodes.name: Burst quality
nodes.description: how much of the damage lands as synchronised bursts on one target

nodes.name: Kill conversion
nodes.description: bursts and pressure that become kills

nodes.name: Mitigation
nodes.description: prots landed on time, blocks, damage prevented

nodes.name: Healing
nodes.description: healing per second and response time to bursts

nodes.name: Monk uptime
nodes.description: share of time monks can cast: not interrupted, knocked down, Dazed or dead

nodes.name: Monk load
nodes.description: casts the backline must make to keep up (overload)
nodes.how: incoming damage against healing per monk

nodes.name: Health ceiling
nodes.description: each player's maximum health after DP, Deep Wound and health-reducing hexes

nodes.name: Sustain margin
nodes.description: incoming damage against healing plus mitigation in a group

nodes.name: Control received
nodes.description: interrupts, knockdowns, Blind, Daze, strips and energy denial taken, by role

nodes.name: Removal capacity
nodes.description: condition and hex removal available against how fast the enemy reapplies

nodes.name: Mobility
nodes.description: speed and snares: how fast a group can collapse, escape or run

nodes.name: Deaths
nodes.description: players killed, with cause (fights.assess)

nodes.name: Wipes
nodes.description: fights where 3+ players or 2+ monks die

nodes.name: Flag lead
nodes.description: the flag position (response on the next capture exchange)

nodes.name: Boosts
nodes.description: boosts won and conceded

nodes.name: Pit NPCs
nodes.description: knights, archers and Bodyguard lost

nodes.name: Lord damage
nodes.description: damage dealt to the enemy Lord (tiebreak)

nodes.name: Time held
nodes.description: seconds a weak side or defence held without losing anything

nodes.name: Enemies tied up
nodes.description: enemy players kept busy by a group, per own player (exchange rate)

nodes.name: Territory
nodes.description: where fights happen: own side, enemy side, pits

nodes.name: Tempo
nodes.description: fights and kills against both res timers; time spent on failed kills

nodes.name: Scoreboard
nodes.description: numbers, DP, flag lead, stand, pit NPCs, Lord damage at any second

nodes.name: Win
nodes.description: the win-probability model: values every result

nodes.name: Taking conditions on oneself
nodes.description: a monk transferring conditions onto itself (Draw Conditions), e.g. Deep Wound and Burning
nodes.how: condition effects whose source is the own team

nodes.name: Death timing on purpose
nodes.description: dying before time on purpose (death sets, not healing), monks dying in base before time to reset energy, and holding a kill until after the enemy's res (timing)
nodes.how: death timing against the res, death set held at death, own heals on the victim in its last seconds

nodes.name: Lord health
nodes.description: the Guild Lord's health, rebuilt from damage, healing, boosts (+1% max health each) and measured natural regeneration
nodes.how: lord.py; regeneration measured by benchmarks.py regen

nodes.name: Lord exposed
nodes.description: the Lord's Bodyguard and both knights are dead
nodes.how: lord.py from pit NPC deaths (full roster, integrity.py)

nodes.name: Lord killed
nodes.description: the Lord dies: how 28 of the first 30 matches ended
nodes.how: nodes.py lord_kill (Lord dies within 30 s while enemies are in its pit)

nodes.name: Fight state
nodes.description: who is winning the fight now: expected deaths per team in the next 10 s
nodes.how: fightstate.py, from the deaths node fitted without the match

nodes.name: Hex pressure
nodes.description: hexes on a player and on its team's live healers
nodes.how: nodes.py deaths and kill_conversion features (replay hex intervals)

nodes.name: Flux
nodes.description: the month's flux (Minion Apocalypse, Meek Shall Inherit, Jack of All Trades, Chain Combo)

nodes.name: Wrong casts
nodes.description: casting into a ready interrupt without cancelling, casting while Dazed, attacking while Blind (every role)

nodes.name: Enchantment strips
nodes.description: strips on the best target in range, valued from data (an enchantment's recorded output plus the bearer's measured drop after a strip)

nodes.name: Blind on enemies
nodes.description: Blind on the enemy frontline, and on players hitting own healers (defensive)

nodes.name: Split depth
nodes.description: how deep a split plays in the enemy base: its nearest member's distance to the defending pit

nodes.name: Kiting
nodes.description: kiting enemy melee (warriors, dervishes, assassins): seconds chased without being hit

nodes.name: Degen pressure
nodes.description: degeneration put on the enemy (conditions and degen hexes), pip-seconds; the replays record degen as no damage

nodes.name: Baited interrupts
nodes.description: enemy interrupts that landed on nothing because the player cancelled

nodes.name: Offensive knockdowns
nodes.description: knockdowns landed on enemies, and on casting targets

nodes.name: Disables
nodes.description: skill-seconds disabled on enemies by Complicate, Power Lock, Power Block and Blackout

nodes.name: Cast prevention
nodes.description: Shame, Guilt and Diversion on enemies: seconds up and casts they punished

nodes.name: Pre-kiting
nodes.description: distance kept from enemy melee heading for the player, before contact (split from P.21, Denning R-283)

waiting.feature: control on the runner by distance to the stand
waiting.why: R-288: control, damage and pushes received read as a reaction because runs that get far get hit; measure them by distance band (far from the stand v near) or before the halfway point, so both run nodes and capture speed read the control where it mattered

waiting.feature: flag dropped by a Shadow Step
waiting.why: R-289: a Shadow Step drops the flag now; a runner who uses one is an execution fault, not a speed asset (replacement for the retired runner_escapes)

R-290: trigger hexes (Mind Wrack) leave the target when they fire, so time-on-player undervalues them; value a hex by its recorded output incl. the damage on trigger or removal and the energy pressure it stands for; and a harmless hex left on is not a fault

waiting.feature: NPC healing by target and kind
waiting.why: R-291: split npc_healing_10s by which NPC was healed (archer, knight, Bodyguard, Lord; under AoE or not) and by heal kind (direct v enchantment), so the data can test the common wisdom (archer over knight under AoE, Bodyguard over Lord) and whether enchantment heals on the Lord cost Lord damage
